title: The process study and parameter influence in Wire Arc Additive Manufacturing (WAAM) of titanium using hot-wire plasma arc welding
authors: Pattarawadee Poolperm
abstract: Abstract This research aims to study and develop the Wire Arc Additive Manufacturing (WAAM) process for titanium alloys utilizing the Hot-Wire Plasma Arc Welding (Hot-Wire PAW) technique. Due to titanium’s high susceptibility to oxidation during melting, a specialized inert gas shielding device was designed. Process optimization was subsequently conducted using a Full Factorial Design of Experiment (DOE) via Minitab software to determine the optimal parameters: a welding speed of 1.83 mm/s, a wire current of 35 A, and a wire feed rate of 0.85 m/min. Microstructural analysis utilizing the EDS technique confirmed the purity of the deposited titanium, indicating zero oxygen contamination. Furthermore, 3D microscopy revealed grain structure variations induced by the repeated thermal cycles inherent to the layer-by-layer deposition process. In-depth mechanical testing also exposed anisotropic behavior; specifically, tensile strength and ductility differed between the vertical and horizontal build directions, with horizontal specimens achieving an Ultimate Tensile Strength (UTS) of 560.80–693.58 MPa, compared to 631.65–677.10 MPa for vertical specimens. Additionally, Vickers hardness values ranged from 199.8 HV to 266.8 HV, demonstrating a decreasing trend along the height of the specimen. The findings of this study establish a crucial foundation for the cost-effective production of high-quality, large-scale titanium components for advanced industrial applications.
venue: Journal of Engineering and Applied Science

infographic.engineering_relevance: The study supports a scalable route to lower-cost titanium part fabrication for aerospace and other high-performance applications.
method: Used a specialized inert gas shielding device to prevent titanium oxidation during melting.

zh-Hans.title: 采用热丝等离子弧焊的钛合金线弧增材制造（WAAM）过程研究与参数影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 本研究旨在利用热丝等离子弧焊（Hot-Wire PAW）技术，研究并开发用于钛合金的线弧增材制造（WAAM）工艺。由于钛在熔化过程中对氧化高度敏感，设计了一种专用惰性气体保护装置。随后采用 Minitab 软件通过全因子试验设计（DOE）进行工艺优化，以确定最佳参数：焊接速度为 1.83 mm/s，送丝电流为 35 A，送丝速度为 0.85 m/min。采用 EDS 技术的微观组织分析证实了沉积钛的纯净性，表明氧污染为零。此外，3D 显微观察揭示了由逐层沉积过程固有的反复热循环所引起的晶粒结构变化。深入的力学测试还显示出各向异性行为；具体而言，拉伸强度和延展性在垂直与水平方向的成形方向之间存在差异，其中水平试样的极限抗拉强度（UTS）为 560.80–693.58 MPa，而垂直试样为 631.65–677.10 MPa。此外，维氏硬度值范围为 199.8 HV 至 266.8 HV，表明其沿试样高度方向呈下降趋势。本研究结果为高质量、大尺寸钛合金构件在先进工业应用中的低成本制造奠定了重要基础。

infographic.key_insight: 热丝等离子弧 WAAM 可在优化参数和有效惰性保护下沉积钛材，形成低污染且性能可控的构件。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该研究为面向航空航天及其他高性能应用的低成本钛合金零件制造提供了可扩展路径。
method: 采用专用惰性气体保护装置以防止钛在熔化过程中氧化。
使用 Minitab 中的全因子 DOE 优化焊接速度、送丝电流和送丝速度。
采用 EDS、3D 显微观察和力学测试对沉积层进行评估。
infographic.evidence_signal: EDS 显示氧污染为零，而力学测试表明水平样品的 UTS 为 560.80–693.58 MPa、垂直样品为 631.65–677.10 MPa，硬度范围为 199.8–266.8 HV。
infographic.watch_item: 该成形件在高度方向上表现出各向异性强度和硬度变化，因此参数迁移和零件认证可能需要按方向进行验证。

title: Application of Six Sigma DMAIC and Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) for Quality Improvement In Shielded Metal Arc Welding Training in Selected Technical Institutions in Imo State, Nigeria: A Comparative Study of Federal College of Land Resource T
authors: Ugonna Johnbull Egbukichi, Ugwuegbu Duke Chiagoro
abstract: Welding quality is influenced by process variation, operator competence, equipment condition, consumable handling and inspection practices. In technical institutions, recurring welding defects can reduce practical training quality, increase material wastage and weaken industrial readiness. This study applies the Six Sigma Define–Measure–Analyze–Improve–Control (DMAIC) methodology with Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) to assess Shielded Metal Arc Welding (SMAW) training at Federal College of Land Resource Technology (FECOLART), Owerri, and Federal Polytechnic Nekede, Owerri, Imo State, Nigeria. The supplied study dataset contained 87 recorded defects classified into lack of fusion, undercut, porosity, slag inclusion, incomplete penetration and excessive spatter. Lack of fusion was the most frequent defect (25.29%), followed by undercut (22.99%) and porosity (21.84%); together these accounted for 70.12% of the recorded defects. FMEA identified lack of fusion and porosity as the highest-priority failure modes, with RPNs of 245 and 240 under the study rating assumptions. The results demonstrate that DMAIC provides a structured improvement pathway while FMEA adds risk-based prioritisation. Recommended controls include standardised welding procedures, preventive maintenance, improved electrode storage, structured inspection, instructor development and periodic review of defect data and FMEA.

infographic.key_insight: DMAIC combined with FMEA pinpoints the most critical SMAW training defects, showing that a structured quality-improvement workflow can substantially target the main sources of welding error.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The study offers a practical, risk-based framework for improving welding instruction, reducing waste, and strengthening shop-floor readiness in technical institutions.
method: Applied Six Sigma DMAIC to assess and improve SMAW training quality.
Used FMEA to rank defect modes by risk priority number (RPN).
Compared defect patterns across two technical institutions in Imo State, Nigeria.

zh-Hans.title: 六西格玛 DMAIC 与失效模式与影响分析（FMEA）在尼日利亚伊莫州部分技术院校屏蔽金属电弧焊培训质量改进中的应用：联邦土地资源技术学院（FECOLART）比较研究
zh-Hans.abstract: 焊接质量受工艺波动、操作人员能力、设备状况、耗材处理和检验实践的影响。在技术院校中，反复出现的焊接缺陷会降低实践培训质量、增加材料浪费并削弱工业就绪能力。本研究采用六西格玛定义–测量–分析–改进–控制（DMAIC）方法，并结合失效模式与影响分析（FMEA），对尼日利亚伊莫州奥韦里的联邦土地资源技术学院（FECOLART）和联邦理工学院 Nekede 奥韦里校区的屏蔽金属电弧焊（SMAW）培训进行评估。所提供的研究数据集包含87个已记录缺陷，分类为未熔合、咬边、气孔、夹渣、未焊透和过量飞溅。未熔合是最常见的缺陷（25.29%），其次是咬边（22.99%）和气孔（21.84%）；三者合计占已记录缺陷的70.12%。FMEA 在研究评分假设下确定未熔合和气孔为最高优先级失效模式，其 RPN 分别为245和240。结果表明，DMAIC 提供了结构化的改进路径，而 FMEA 增加了基于风险的优先排序。建议的控制措施包括标准化焊接工艺、预防性维护、改进电极存储、结构化检验、教师能力提升以及对缺陷数据和 FMEA 的定期复审。

infographic.key_insight: DMAIC 与 FMEA 的结合可锁定最关键的 SMAW 培训缺陷，表明结构化的质量改进流程能够显著针对焊接错误的主要来源。

title: Feasibility Study on the Production of Fillet Welds with Defined Throat Thickness Using Wire-Based Corner Fillet Friction Stir Welding
authors: Stefan Donaubauer, Johannes Eppinger, Stefan Weihe, Martin Werz
abstract: Friction stir welding of T- and corner-joint configurations is challenging due to restricted tool accessibility, complex material flow and the limited availability of material for the formation of load-bearing fillet-weld geometries. This study introduces wire-based corner fillet friction stir welding (W-CFFSW), a solid-state joining process in which filler wire is continuously transported, plasticised and supplied into the internal corner region through a rotating extrusion screw. A stationary shoulder confines and shapes the deposited material, enabling the formation of fillet welds with a defined throat thickness. Single- and double-sided fillet-weld geometries were produced in 3.0 mm thick EN AW-6082-T6 sheets using EN AW-6082 filler wire. A throat thickness of 4.5 mm was successfully generated by adapting the supplied filler volume to the targeted fillet geometry. Metallographic investigations revealed characteristic FSW microstructural zones and pronounced material flow within the weld nugget zone, while no macroscopic pores or voids were observed in the investigated cross-sections. The hardness distribution exhibited the characteristic W-shaped profile of precipitation-hardenable aluminium alloys. Bending tests showed no separation of the bonding interfaces, with cracking occurring in the adjacent sheet material rather than within the fillet welds. Tensile strengths of 231.55 MPa and 217.49 MPa were achieved for stiffener- and stringer-loaded specimens, corresponding to joint efficiencies of 66 % and 62 %, respectively. The results demonstrate that W-CFFSW enables the controlled addition of filler material to produce mechanically load-bearing fillet welds with a defined throat thickness and represents a promising alternative to existing friction-stir-based T- and corner-joint processes.
venue: Journal of Manufacturing and Materials Processing

infographic.key_insight: Wire-based corner fillet friction stir welding can continuously feed filler metal to form load-bearing fillet welds with a controlled throat thickness.
infographic.engineering_relevance: This offers a solid-state alternative for producing stronger T- and corner-joint fillets in aluminum structures where conventional friction stir welding has limited access and insufficient material supply.
method: Continuously transport filler wire through a rotating extrusion screw into the internal corner region.
Use a stationary shoulder to confine and shape the plasticised material.
Produce single- and double-sided fillet geometries in 3.0 mm EN AW-6082-T6 sheets with EN AW-6082 filler wire.

infographic.paper_title: Feasibility Study on the Production of Fillet Welds with Defined Throat Thickness Using Wire-Based Corner Fillet Friction Stir Welding

zh-Hans.title: 采用基于丝材的角部角焊缝搅拌摩擦焊制备具有规定喉厚的角焊缝的可行性研究
zh-Hans.abstract: 由于工具可达性受限、材料流动复杂以及用于形成承载型角焊缝几何形状的材料供应有限，T形和角接接头构型的搅拌摩擦焊具有挑战性。本研究提出基于丝材的角部角焊缝搅拌摩擦焊（W-CFFSW），这是一种固相连接工艺，其中填充丝材通过旋转挤压螺杆连续输送、塑化并供入内角区域。固定肩部对沉积材料进行约束和成形，从而能够形成具有规定喉厚的角焊缝。采用 EN AW-6082 填充丝材，在 3.0 mm 厚的 EN AW-6082-T6 板材上制备了单侧和双侧角焊缝几何形状。通过调整供给的填充材料体积以匹配目标角焊缝几何形状，成功获得了 4.5 mm 的喉厚。金相研究显示出典型的 FSW 显微组织分区以及焊核区内显著的材料流动，而在所研究的横截面中未观察到宏观孔洞或空隙。硬度分布呈现出可析出硬化铝合金特有的 W 形曲线。弯曲试验未显示结合界面分离，裂纹出现在相邻板材材料中而非角焊缝内部。对于加强筋加载试样和纵筋加载试样，分别获得了 231.55 MPa 和 217.49 MPa 的拉伸强度，对应的接头效率分别为 66 % 和 62 %。结果表明，W-CFFSW 能够实现受控添加填充材料，从而制备具有规定喉厚、可承受机械载荷的角焊缝，并且是现有基于搅拌摩擦的 T 形和角接接头工艺的一种有前景的替代方案。

infographic.key_insight: 基于丝材的角部角焊缝搅拌摩擦焊可以连续供给填充金属，形成具有可控喉厚的承载型角焊缝。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这为铝结构中生产更高强度的 T 形和角接接头角焊缝提供了一种固相替代方案，适用于传统搅拌摩擦焊存在可达性受限和材料供给不足的场景。
method: 通过旋转挤压螺杆将填充丝材连续输送至内角区域。
利用固定肩部对塑化材料进行约束和成形。
使用 EN AW-6082 填充丝材，在 3.0 mm EN AW-6082-T6 板材上制备单侧和双侧角焊缝几何形状。
infographic.evidence_signal: 横截面显示出典型的 FSW 分区，且未见宏观孔洞或空隙；试验得到的拉伸强度分别为 231.55 MPa 和 217.49 MPa，接头效率分别为 66% 和 62%。

title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene
authors: A. Alhourani, I. Barsoum, J. Sheikh-Ahmad, S. Deveci
abstract: Friction stir welding (FSW) has gained recognition as an effective technique for joining thermoplastic materials. This study presents a comprehensive investigation to predict FSW characteristics such as weld temperatures, vertical axial forces, material flow and defect formation in FSW of high-density polyethylene (HDPE) using both computational and machine learning approaches, validated by experimental results. A three-dimensional Coupled Eulerian-Lagrangian (CEL) numerical model is developed to simulate the HDPE welding process under varying process parameters of rotational and welding speeds, and bottom preheating conditions. The CEL numerical model is validated against experimental data, showing markedly good agreement in predicting void formation, thermal and mechanical responses. Results indicate that preheating the bottom surface proved effective in reducing thermal gradients and stabilizing vertical force fluctuations. Quantitatively, bottom-surface preheating at 60 °C reduced peak plunge force from 1600 N close to 1100 N and raised peak temperatures from 70 °C (without preheat) to about 100 °C, hence smoothing through-thickness gradients and stabilizing the axial force distribution. In parallel, two multilayer perceptron artificial neural networks (ANNs) are trained on experimental data to predict temporal temperature and axial force responses with R2 between 0.91 and 0.99, demonstrating high accuracy and strong generalization across the tested FSW parameter space. The computational CEL simulations accurately predicted weld zone morphology, including stir zone, thermo-mechanically affected zone and heat-affected zone, however the combined CEL–ANN framework enables rapid generation of process maps that highlights defective and defect-free welding windows, with optimal conditions obtained at 1500 rpm and 30 mm/min with 60 °C preheating, and poor weldability observed at 1000 rpm without preheating due to wormhole formation. These findings provide process-driven design guidelines for developing robust HDPE joints and demonstrate how integrating computational modeling with machine learning enables efficient optimization, offering valuable insights into the key characteristics of the FSW process in thermoplastics and supporting its broader adoption in industrial applications.

infographic.key_insight: A combined CEL simulation and ANN workflow can accurately predict friction stir welding quality in HDPE, revealing that bottom preheating stabilizes forces, raises temperatures, and reduces defect risk.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The study provides a practical process map for selecting welding speed, rotation speed, and preheating settings to improve weld integrity and avoid wormholes in thermoplastic joining.
method: 3D coupled Eulerian-Lagrangian (CEL) model of HDPE FSW
Two multilayer perceptron ANNs trained on experimental temperature and axial-force data
Process-window comparison across rotational speed, travel speed, and bottom preheating conditions
infographic.evidence_signal: The ANN models achieved R2 values of 0.91–0.99, and the CEL results matched experiments for void formation, thermal response, and mechanical force trends.
infographic.watch_item: The process map is based on a limited tested parameter space, so broader materials, tool geometries, and operating ranges may require retraining or revalidation.
infographic.paper_title: Computational and machine learning modelling approaches for weld quality predictions in friction stir welding of high-density polyethylene

zh-Hans.title: 用于高密度聚乙烯搅拌摩擦焊焊接质量预测的计算与机器学习建模方法
zh-Hans.abstract: 搅拌摩擦焊（FSW）作为一种用于连接热塑性材料的有效技术，已获得广泛认可。本研究结合计算方法与机器学习方法，并通过实验结果验证，系统研究了高密度聚乙烯（HDPE）搅拌摩擦焊中的焊接特征预测，如焊缝温度、垂直轴向力、材料流动及缺陷形成。建立了三维耦合欧拉-拉格朗日（CEL）数值模型，用于模拟在不同工艺参数（转速、焊接速度以及底部预热条件）下的HDPE焊接过程。CEL数值模型与实验数据进行了对比验证，在孔洞形成、热响应和力学响应预测方面表现出显著良好的一致性。结果表明，对底表面进行预热可有效降低热梯度并稳定垂向力波动。定量而言，底表面在60 °C预热时，可将峰值压入力从接近1600 N降至约1100 N，并将峰值温度从70 °C（无预热）提高到约100 °C，从而平滑厚度方向梯度并稳定轴向力分布。与此同时，基于实验数据训练了两个多层感知机人工神经网络（ANN），用于预测温度和轴向力的时变响应，其R2介于0.91和0.99之间，表明在所测试的FSW参数空间内具有很高的准确性和良好的泛化能力。计算CEL模拟能够准确预测焊缝区形貌，包括搅拌区、热-机影响区和热影响区；而CEL–ANN联合框架则可快速生成工艺图，突出显示有缺陷和无缺陷的焊接窗口，其中在1500 rpm和30 mm/min、并采用60 °C预热时获得最佳工况，而在1000 rpm且无预热条件下由于虫洞形成而表现出较差的焊接性。这些结果为开发稳健的HDPE接头提供了以工艺为导向的设计指南，并表明将计算建模与机器学习相结合能够实现高效优化，为理解热塑性材料FSW过程的关键特征提供了有价值的见解，并支持其在工业应用中的更广泛采用。

infographic.key_insight: 结合CEL仿真与ANN的工作流程可准确预测HDPE搅拌摩擦焊质量，并揭示底部预热能够稳定力、提高温度并降低缺陷风险。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该研究提供了一张实用的工艺图，可用于选择焊接速度、转速和预热设置，以提高焊接完整性并避免热塑性连接中的虫洞。
method: HDPE搅拌摩擦焊的三维耦合欧拉-拉格朗日（CEL）模型
基于实验温度和轴向力数据训练的两个多层感知机ANN
跨转速、行进速度和底部预热条件的工艺窗口比较
infographic.evidence_signal: ANN模型的R2值达到0.91–0.99，且CEL结果在孔洞形成、热响应和机械力趋势方面与实验相吻合。
infographic.watch_item: 该工艺图基于有限的已测试参数空间，因此更广泛的材料、工具几何形状和运行范围可能需要重新训练或重新验证。

title: Effect of spray distance in D-gun sprayed Cr3C2–NiCr coatings on DSS 2205 in acidic environments
authors: Roshan Kuruvila, Mebin T Kuruvila, Manu Harilal, S. Thirumalai Kumaran
abstract: Cermet coating, which is a blend of ceramic hardness and metallic toughness, is mostly applied to enhance the wear and corrosion resistance of metals. Detonation gun ( D -gun) spraying is one of the most promising thermal spray technologies that would produce a high-quality ceramic coating. Cr 3 C 2 -NiCr coating is acceptable because of its superior mechanical characteristics and corrosion characteristic. The effectiveness of D -gun sprayed Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings was evaluated under aggressive acidic conditions using 1 M H₂SO₄, which serves as a standardized laboratory electrolyte for assessing corrosion resistance relevant to industrial acidic environments, including the key process variables such as spraying distance, which is critically important in the determination of other coating properties such as porosity, adhesion, roughness, and hardness. Duplex stainless steel (DSS) 2205 has been sprayed with Cr 3 C 2 -NiCr at three spraying distances; 170 mm, 180 mm and 190 mm in an attempt to conduct the research on the behavior of Cr 3 C 2 -NiCr in acid conditions. Electrochemical activity of the coating was evaluated in 1 M H 2 SO 4 solutions at room temperature; by open circuit potential (OCP), electrochemical impedance spectroscopy and potentiodynamic polarisation. Investigation of surface morphology under SEM revealed dense lamellar coatings with porosity decreasing from 2.84% at 170 mm to 1.38% at 190 mm, indicating improved particle melting and coating compactness. The coating deposited at 190 mm exhibited the best electrochemical performance, with lowest corrosion rate (0.113 mmpy), compared with the uncoated substrate (2.60 mmpy). All coated specimens had a homogenous and compact coating structure. The results demonstrate that 190 mm is the optimum spray distance for producing high-integrity Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings on DSS 2205, providing enhanced corrosion protection for components operating in aggressive acidic industrial environments. This work demonstrates that optimizing the D -gun spray distance significantly influences the microstructural integrity and electrochemical corrosion behaviour of Cr₃C₂–25NiCr coatings on DSS 2205. The established processing–microstructure–performance relationship provides a scientific basis for optimizing D -gun coating parameters to enhance corrosion resistance in aggressive acidic environments.

infographic.engineering_relevance: Optimizing D-gun spray distance can substantially improve coating integrity and extend the service life of stainless steel components in acidic industrial environments.

zh-Hans.title: D-gun喷涂Cr3C2–NiCr涂层喷涂距离对酸性环境中DSS 2205的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 金属陶瓷涂层是陶瓷硬度与金属韧性的结合，主要用于提高金属的耐磨性和耐腐蚀性。爆炸喷枪（D-gun）喷涂是最有前景的热喷涂技术之一，可制备高质量陶瓷涂层。Cr3C2-NiCr涂层因其优异的力学性能和耐蚀特性而具有应用价值。本研究采用1 M H2SO4在强酸性条件下评估D-gun喷涂Cr3C2–NiCr涂层的有效性；该溶液作为标准化实验室电解质，用于评估与工业酸性环境相关的耐腐蚀性，其中包括喷涂距离等关键工艺变量，而喷涂距离对孔隙率、结合强度、粗糙度和硬度等其他涂层性能的确定至关重要。将2205双相不锈钢（DSS）在170 mm、180 mm和190 mm三种喷涂距离下喷涂Cr3C2-NiCr，以研究Cr3C2-NiCr在酸性条件下的行为。通过开路电位（OCP）、电化学阻抗谱和动电位极化，在室温下于1 M H2SO4溶液中评估了涂层的电化学活性。SEM下的表面形貌研究表明，涂层为致密层状结构，孔隙率随喷涂距离从170 mm时的2.84%降至190 mm时的1.38%，说明颗粒熔融更充分、涂层更致密。190 mm喷涂距离制备的涂层表现出最佳电化学性能，其腐蚀速率最低（0.113 mmpy），而未涂覆基体为2.60 mmpy。所有涂覆试样均具有均匀且致密的涂层结构。结果表明，190 mm是制备DSS 2205上高完整性Cr3C2–NiCr涂层的最佳喷涂距离，可为在强酸性工业环境中工作的部件提供更强的耐腐蚀保护。本研究表明，优化D-gun喷涂距离会显著影响DSS 2205上Cr3C2–25NiCr涂层的微观结构完整性和电化学腐蚀行为。所建立的工艺—微观结构—性能关系为优化D-gun涂层参数、提高强酸性环境中的耐腐蚀性提供了科学依据。

比较不同喷涂距离下的SEM显微组织和孔隙率。

title: Analysis of tensile properties, fracture characteristics, and microstructural features in friction stir welding of dissimilar aluminium alloys reinforced with Al 2 O 3
authors: R. Raja, Sabitha Jannet, Ebenezer Jacob Dhas D. S, Sabarish S, R. Pandiyarajan, K. Anton Savio Lewise
abstract: In the present investigation, dissimilar aluminium alloys AA2014-T6 and AA5083-H111 were joined using friction stir welding combined with in-situ reinforcement of aluminium oxide (Al2O3) particles. A single V-groove with an included angle of 45° was machined along the welded joint line, into which Al2O3 particles were introduced prior to subsequent friction stir processing. The welded joints were subjected to three friction stir processing passes to promote effective material flow and particle dispersion. Microhardness measurements revealed values of up to 105 VHN in the stir zone, while tensile testing showed an improvement of up to 18% compared to the unreinforced joint. Scanning electron microscopy (SEM) observations indicated the distribution of Al2O3 particles and effective mixing within the stir zone, and elemental mapping verified the presence of reinforcement across the processed region. Fractographic analysis indicated predominantly ductile fracture characterized by equiaxed dimples. Wear testing showed that the 9 wt.% Al2O3 condition exhibited the lowest wear rate among the investigated reinforcement levels.

infographic.engineering_relevance: The study suggests a practical route to strengthen dissimilar aluminium welds by combining groove-filling reinforcement with multi-pass friction stir processing.

Inserted Al2O3 particles into the groove and applied three friction stir processing passes.
Evaluated microhardness, tensile behavior, wear performance, SEM/EDS mapping, and fracture morphology.

infographic.watch_item: The benefits depend on uniform particle dispersion and process control; excessive or uneven reinforcement could compromise weld consistency.
infographic.paper_title: Analysis of tensile properties, fracture characteristics, and microstructural features in friction stir welding of dissimilar aluminium alloys reinforced with Al 2 O 3

zh-Hans.title: 采用Al2O3增强的异种铝合金摩擦搅拌焊中拉伸性能、断裂特征及微观结构特征分析
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究采用摩擦搅拌焊，并结合原位增强氧化铝（Al2O3）颗粒，连接了异种铝合金AA2014-T6和AA5083-H111。在焊缝接头线上加工出一个夹角为45°的单V形坡口，并在随后进行摩擦搅拌加工之前将Al2O3颗粒引入其中。焊接接头进行了三道摩擦搅拌加工，以促进材料的有效流动和颗粒分散。显微硬度测量显示搅拌区最高可达105 VHN，而拉伸试验表明，相比未增强接头，其性能提高了最高18%。扫描电子显微镜（SEM）观察表明Al2O3颗粒分布于搅拌区且混合效果良好，元素映射验证了增强相在加工区域内的存在。断口形貌分析表明断裂以韧性断裂为主，其特征为等轴韧窝。磨损试验表明，在所研究的增强水平中，9 wt.% Al2O3条件下的磨损率最低。

infographic.engineering_relevance: 该研究表明，通过将坡口填充增强与多道次摩擦搅拌加工相结合，可为增强异种铝焊接提供一条实用途径。

评估了显微硬度、拉伸行为、磨损性能、SEM/EDS映射以及断裂形貌。

title: Influence of Tib2 Reinforcement and Tool Traverse Speed on the Structural and Thermal Behavior of Dissimilar Metals (AA7075–AA2024) of Friction Stir Welded Joints: an ABAQUS Study
authors: A. Ramaswamy, M. Pujith, N. Vinod, M. Srikanth, M. Deepak
abstract: Friction Stir Welding (FSW) is a modern solid-state joining technique known for its energy efficiency, strong joints, and minimal environmental impact. This project focuses on joining two dissimilar high-strength aluminium alloys AA7075 and AA2024 using the simulation software ABAQUS. The welding was performed on the plates measuring 200 mm in length, 60 mm in width, and 6 mm in thickness. In this study, a Finite Element (FE) simulation was performed to understand the structural and thermal behaviour during welding. Various process parameters were tested, including tool rotational speed, feed rate and tilt angle to identify the most effective settings for achieving strong and defect-free joints. The simulation showed that the welding parameters were Tool speeds of 1000,2000 and 3000 rpm; Feed rates of 1,2 and 3 mm/sec; Tilt angles of 10,1.50 and 2°. These parameters produced in a moderate peak temperature of approximately 580°C, which is within the ideal plasticization range for both AA7075 and AA2024 without exceeding their melting points. This ensures proper material flow, defect-free weld formation, and maintenance of the mechanical properties.

title: Early detection of groove defect in friction stir welding through data-driven process monitoring
authors: Ersilia Cozzolino, Vitantonio Esperto, Felice Rubino, Antonello Astarita, Pierpaolo Carlone
abstract: Abstract Friction stir welding (FSW) is widely employed for joining aluminum alloys in aerospace and transportation applications. However, process instabilities may lead to groove defects that compromise joint quality and often become evident only after their macroscopic manifestation. Existing monitoring approaches frequently rely on dedicated sensors, such as dynamometers, accelerometers, or acoustic-emission systems, increasing system complexity and implementation costs. This study proposes a data-driven approach for the early detection of groove defects based on electrical current signals acquired from the spindle and machine axes of a CNC machining center used for FSW. Defect-free and groove-defective lap joints of dissimilar AA2139 and AA7075 aluminum alloys were produced and analyzed through signal segmentation, Fast Fourier Transform (FFT), power spectral density (PSD), and spectral coherence analysis. The monitoring methodology was subsequently tested on a weld exhibiting transient groove formation and correlated with X-ray computed tomography (XCT) observations. The results showed that spindle current signals provide the most sensitive indication of groove-defect formation. Defect-free weld regions exhibited high spectral coherence values, whereas defective regions were characterized by a significant reduction in coherence at the spindle fundamental frequency and its harmonics. XCT analyses confirmed that these signal variations are associated with the development of subsurface discontinuities preceding the appearance of visible surface grooves. The proposed methodology identified process instabilities within approximately 10 s from defect initiation, demonstrating the existence of an incubation stage before the macroscopic manifestation of the groove defect. The approach only requires low-cost current measurements readily available in industrial CNC machining centers used for FSW, making it suitable for industrial implementation and a promising tool for real-time FSW monitoring and quality control.
venue: The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology

zh-Hans.title: 通过数据驱动的过程监测早期检测搅拌摩擦焊中的沟槽缺陷
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 搅拌摩擦焊（FSW）广泛用于航空航天和交通运输领域铝合金的连接。然而，工艺不稳定可能导致沟槽缺陷，损害接头质量，且往往只有在其宏观表征出现后才会显现。现有监测方法通常依赖测力台、加速度计或声发射系统等专用传感器，从而增加了系统复杂性和实施成本。本研究提出一种基于数据驱动的方法，利用用于FSW的CNC加工中心主轴和机床各轴所采集的电流信号，对沟槽缺陷进行早期检测。采用异种AA2139和AA7075铝合金制备了无缺陷和存在沟槽缺陷的搭接接头，并通过信号分段、快速傅里叶变换（FFT）、功率谱密度（PSD）和频谱相干性分析进行研究。随后将该监测方法应用于一条表现出瞬态沟槽形成的焊缝，并与X射线计算机断层扫描（XCT）观测结果进行关联。结果表明，主轴电流信号对沟槽缺陷的形成最为敏感。无缺陷焊缝区域表现出较高的频谱相干值，而缺陷区域则在主轴基频及其谐波处的相干性显著降低。XCT分析证实，这些信号变化与可见表面沟槽出现之前的亚表面不连续性发展有关。所提出的方法在缺陷起始后约10 s内识别出工艺不稳定性，表明沟槽缺陷的宏观表征之前存在一个潜伏阶段。该方法仅需FSW工业CNC加工中心中可直接获得的低成本电流测量信号，因而适用于工业实施，并有望成为实时FSW监测和质量控制的有力工具。

title: Rupture and growth of holes in the melt pool during laser keyhole welding of thin sheets
authors: Love O. John, Alexander F.H. Kaplan
abstract: Abstract This study investigates the formation and growth of holes during laser keyhole welding of 100 μm thin 316 L stainless-steel sheets in overlap joints, represented by bead-on-plate welding of 200 μm thick foils. Using high-speed imaging, keyhole instabilities, promoted by increasing line energy, were identified as precursors to hole nucleation. Continuous weld seams were obtained up to approximately 7 kJ/m, while hole formation occurred beyond this regime and cutting became dominant above approximately 12 kJ/m. The hole growth mechanism is described by the competition between vertical and horizontal surface-tension components associated with the local melt pool curvature. Once nucleated, holes expanded at approximately 0.8–1.2 m/s over 1–3 ms and developed into elliptical shapes before forming permanent perforations or cuts. A geometric stability criterion based on the Young-Laplace force balance indicates that unstable growth occurs when the hole length becomes comparable to the sheet thickness. The thinner the foil, the stronger the vertical force component promoting hole growth, reaching 17 kN/m² here. A systematic flow chart linking the observed sequence of keyhole instability, hole nucleation, and hole growth provides a basis for identifying precursor signatures and suppressing hole formation during thin-sheet laser welding.
venue: The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology

infographic.engineering_relevance: The work provides a practical stability criterion and process window for suppressing hole formation in ultra-thin sheet welding by controlling energy input and monitoring precursor keyhole behavior.

zh-Hans.title: 激光小孔焊接薄板熔池中孔洞的破裂与生长
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 本研究以200 μm厚箔材的搭接接头平板焊接为代表，研究了100 μm薄316L不锈钢板在激光小孔焊接过程中孔洞的形成与生长。通过高速成像发现，随着线能量增加而增强的小孔不稳定性是孔洞成核的前兆。在约7 kJ/m以内可获得连续焊缝，而超过该范围后开始出现孔洞形成，并且在约12 kJ/m以上切割占主导。孔洞生长机制可由与局部熔池曲率相关的垂直与水平表面张力分量之间的竞争来描述。一旦成核，孔洞在1–3 ms内以约0.8–1.2 m/s的速度扩展，并在形成永久性穿孔或切割前发展为椭圆形。基于Young-Laplace力平衡的几何稳定性判据表明，当孔洞长度与板厚相当时，会发生不稳定生长。箔材越薄，促进孔洞生长的垂直力分量越强，此处达到17 kN/m²。将所观察到的小孔不稳定、孔洞成核和孔洞生长的顺序联系起来的系统流程图，为识别前兆特征以及在薄板激光焊接中抑制孔洞形成提供了依据。

infographic.key_insight: 在薄316L箔材激光小孔焊接中，线能量增加会触发小孔不稳定性并诱发孔洞成核，随后孔洞快速生长，使工艺从良好焊缝转变为穿孔或切割。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该研究提供了一个实用的稳定性判据和工艺窗口，可通过控制能量输入并监测前兆性小孔行为来抑制超薄板焊接中的孔洞形成。
method: 采用高速成像对100 μm 316L搭接接头的激光小孔焊接进行观测，并以200 μm箔材的平板焊接作为替代

利用Young-Laplace表面张力力平衡和几何稳定性判据解释孔洞生长

title: Microstructure, Wear and Corrosion Resistances of Atmospheric Plasma, Detonation, High Velocity Oxy-fuel and High Velocity Air-fuel Sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr Cemented Carbide Coatings
authors: Ting XIA, Yueming WANG, Lu XIE
abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr cemented carbide coating has the advantages of superior wear property and corrosion resistance. WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were prepared on 304 stainless steel substrates by different thermal spray technologies including atmospheric plasma spraying (APS), detonation spraying (DS), high velocity oxy-fuel spraying (HVOFS), and high velocity air-fuel spraying (HVAFS), respectively. The microstructure, tribological properties and corrosion resistances of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings were systematically investigated and compared. The results showed that the Vickers hardness of cemented coatings prepared by APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF, which were all higher than those of 304 stainless steel, were 771.4 HV, 954.2 HV, 1166.2 HV, and 1162.2 HV, respectively. The volume wear rate of 304 stainless steel was about (36.82±0.80)×10-5 mm3/N·m. The volume wear rates of APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF coatings, which were all lower than that of 304 stainless steel, were about (7.93±0.30)×10-5, (1.51±0.20)×10-5, (1.17±0.10)×10-5, and (1.10±0.01)×10-5 mm3/N·m, respectively. In addition, the average friction coefficients of 304 stainless steel substrate, APS coating, DS one, HVOF one and HVAF one were about (0.68±0.03), (0.56±0.02), (0.48±0.01), (0.44±0.01) and (0.43±0.01), respectively. Spalling, microcracks perpendicular to the friction direction, and grooves parallel to the friction direction can be found in the wear marks of WC-10Co-4Cr coatings. Abrasive wear and fatigue wear are the main wear mechanisms of the cemented coatings. During the wear test, the carbide particles in DS, HVOF and HVAF coatings gradually became the main body bearing the friction load. Then the wear resistance of the latter three coatings was all superior to that of APS. Moreover, HVOF and HVAF coatings have better wear performances. For corrosion resistance from high to low were HVAF coating, DS one, HVOF one and APS one, respectively. The HVAF coating demonstrated the highest corrosion potential (-0.37±0.01 VSCE), smallest corrosion current density (1.75±0.02 μA/cm²), and largest corrosion resistance (20438.5 Ω) here. The APS coating had the poorest corrosion resistance among these four coatings.

infographic.key_insight: Among WC-10Co-4Cr coatings on 304 stainless steel, higher-velocity spray processes produced denser, harder coatings with much better wear and corrosion performance than atmospheric plasma spraying.
infographic.engineering_relevance: For wear- and corrosion-critical surfaces, HVOF and HVAF are the strongest choices here, with HVAF giving the best overall corrosion resistance and top-tier wear resistance.
method: WC-10Co-4Cr cemented carbide coatings were deposited on 304 stainless steel using APS, DS, HVOF, and HVAF.
Microstructure, hardness, tribological behavior, and electrochemical corrosion performance were compared across the four spray routes.
Wear tracks and corrosion metrics were used to identify dominant degradation mechanisms and process-performance tradeoffs.
infographic.evidence_signal: Compared with 304 stainless steel, coating hardness increased to 771.4–1166.2 HV, wear rate dropped from 36.82×10^-5 to 1.10–7.93×10^-5 mm3/N·m, friction coefficient fell from 0.68 to 0.43–0.56, and HVAF showed the best corrosion results (Ecorr -0.37 VSCE, Icorr 1.75 μA/cm²).
infographic.watch_item: Results are specific to this coating chemistry, substrate, and test conditions, so process selection should still account for part geometry, cost, residual stress, and service environment.
infographic.paper_title: Microstructure, Wear and Corrosion Resistances of Atmospheric Plasma, Detonation, High Velocity Oxy-fuel and High Velocity Air-fuel Sprayed WC-10Co-4Cr Cemented Carbide Coatings

zh-Hans.title: 大气等离子喷涂、爆炸喷涂、高速氧燃料喷涂和高速空气燃料喷涂WC-10Co-4Cr硬质合金涂层的显微组织、耐磨性与耐腐蚀性
zh-Hans.abstract: WC-10Co-4Cr硬质合金涂层具有优异的耐磨性能和耐腐蚀性。采用大气等离子喷涂（APS）、爆炸喷涂（DS）、高速氧燃料喷涂（HVOFS）和高速空气燃料喷涂（HVAFS）等不同热喷涂技术，在304不锈钢基体上制备了WC-10Co-4Cr涂层。系统研究并比较了WC-10Co-4Cr涂层的显微组织、摩擦学性能和耐腐蚀性。结果表明，采用APS、DS、HVOF和HVAF制备的硬质合金涂层维氏硬度均高于304不锈钢，分别为771.4 HV、954.2 HV、1166.2 HV和1162.2 HV。304不锈钢的体积磨损率约为(36.82±0.80)×10-5 mm3/N·m。APS、DS、HVOF和HVAF涂层的体积磨损率均低于304不锈钢，分别约为(7.93±0.30)×10-5、(1.51±0.20)×10-5、(1.17±0.10)×10-5和(1.10±0.01)×10-5 mm3/N·m。此外，304不锈钢基体、APS涂层、DS涂层、HVOF涂层和HVAF涂层的平均摩擦系数分别约为(0.68±0.03)、(0.56±0.02)、(0.48±0.01)、(0.44±0.01)和(0.43±0.01)。WC-10Co-4Cr涂层的磨痕中可见剥落、垂直于摩擦方向的微裂纹以及平行于摩擦方向的沟槽。磨粒磨损和疲劳磨损是这些硬质合金涂层的主要磨损机制。在磨损试验过程中，DS、HVOF和HVAF涂层中的碳化物颗粒逐渐成为承受摩擦载荷的主体，因此后三种涂层的耐磨性均优于APS涂层。此外，HVOF和HVAF涂层具有更好的耐磨性能。耐腐蚀性从高到低依次为HVAF涂层、DS涂层、HVOF涂层和APS涂层。HVAF涂层表现出最高的腐蚀电位（-0.37±0.01 VSCE）、最小的腐蚀电流密度（1.75±0.02 μA/cm²）和最大的耐腐蚀性（20438.5 Ω）。在这四种涂层中，APS涂层的耐腐蚀性最差。

infographic.key_insight: 在304不锈钢上的WC-10Co-4Cr涂层中，更高速度的喷涂工艺可制备出更致密、更硬的涂层，其耐磨和耐腐蚀性能都远优于大气等离子喷涂。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 对于耐磨和耐腐蚀关键表面，在这里HVOF和HVAF是最佳选择，其中HVAF具有最优的整体耐腐蚀性和一流的耐磨性。
method: 采用APS、DS、HVOF和HVAF在304不锈钢上沉积WC-10Co-4Cr硬质合金涂层。
比较四种喷涂工艺下涂层的显微组织、硬度、摩擦学行为和电化学腐蚀性能。
通过磨痕和腐蚀指标识别主导失效机制及工艺-性能权衡关系。
infographic.evidence_signal: 与304不锈钢相比，涂层硬度提高到771.4–1166.2 HV，磨损率从36.82×10^-5降至1.10–7.93×10^-5 mm3/N·m，摩擦系数从0.68降至0.43–0.56，而HVAF表现出最佳的腐蚀结果（Ecorr -0.37 VSCE，Icorr 1.75 μA/cm²）。
infographic.watch_item: 结果仅适用于该涂层化学成分、基体和测试条件，因此工艺选择仍需考虑零件几何形状、成本、残余应力和服役环境。

title: A hierarchical collision free path planning method for multi line spatial distributed welding of non standard workpieces
authors: Lei Hong, Yajie Chu, Zhenhao Wang
abstract: This paper presents a hierarchical path planning method for automatic generation of collision-free welding paths for non-standard workpieces with complex spatial weld distributions. Weld seam information is interactively extracted from CAD models using OpenCASCADE. Path nodes are classified into primary nodes (weld endpoints) and auxiliary nodes (safety points), defining four distinct path types. A two-stage obstacle avoidance strategy is then adopted: local attitude adjustment for short approach/retreat paths, and a global replanning framework built upon vanilla ABIT* with a novel distance-dependent three-stage adaptive optimization objective for long transitional paths. The three-stage objective partitions the path based on distances to the start and goal states, with differentiated cost functions for directional guidance, obstacle avoidance, and goal convergence. Experimental results on typical box-type workpieces demonstrate that the proposed method reduces average path length by 20% and increases minimum clearance by 8% compared to the baseline, while effectively eliminating excessively long paths, and retry operations raise the practical success rate from 52 to 90.7%. This work provides a systematic offline programming solution for welding robots, significantly reducing manual programming effort compared to traditional teach-in methods, while eliminating collisions in physical trials.

infographic.key_insight: A hierarchical planner combines local pose adjustment and global replanning to generate collision-free welding paths for non-standard workpieces with complex spatial seam layouts.
infographic.engineering_relevance: This enables more reliable offline programming for welding robots, reducing manual teach-in effort while improving safety and path quality in real shop-floor applications.
method: Extract weld seams from CAD models with OpenCASCADE and classify path nodes into primary endpoints and auxiliary safety points.
Use two-stage obstacle avoidance: local attitude adjustment for short approach/retreat segments and global replanning for long transition segments.
Apply vanilla ABIT* with a distance-dependent three-stage adaptive objective to balance guidance, obstacle clearance, and goal convergence.
infographic.evidence_signal: On typical box-type workpieces, the method reduced average path length by 20%, increased minimum clearance by 8%, and improved practical success rate from 52% to 90.7% with retries.
infographic.watch_item: Performance depends on accurate CAD seam extraction and careful tuning of the staged objective and replanning logic for different workpiece geometries.
infographic.paper_title: A hierarchical collision free path planning method for multi line spatial distributed welding of non standard workpieces

zh-Hans.title: 一种用于非标工件多线空间分布焊接的分层无碰撞路径规划方法
zh-Hans.abstract: 本文提出一种分层路径规划方法，用于为具有复杂空间焊缝分布的非标工件自动生成无碰撞焊接路径。利用 OpenCASCADE 从 CAD 模型中交互式提取焊缝信息。将路径节点分为主节点（焊缝端点）和辅助节点（安全点），从而定义四种不同的路径类型。随后采用两阶段避障策略：对于短的接近/撤离路径，进行局部姿态调整；对于长的过渡路径，构建在 vanilla ABIT* 基础上的全局重规划框架，并提出一种新的距离相关三阶段自适应优化目标。该三阶段目标根据到起始状态和目标状态的距离对路径进行分段，并针对方向引导、障碍物规避和目标收敛采用差异化代价函数。典型箱体类工件上的实验结果表明，与基线方法相比，所提方法将平均路径长度降低了 20%，将最小安全间隙提高了 8%，同时有效消除了过长路径，并且重试操作将实际成功率从 52% 提高到 90.7%。该工作为焊接机器人提供了一种系统化的离线编程解决方案，相比传统示教方法显著减少了人工编程工作量，同时在物理试验中消除了碰撞。

infographic.key_insight: 分层规划器结合局部姿态调整和全局重规划，为具有复杂空间焊缝布局的非标工件生成无碰撞焊接路径。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这使焊接机器人的离线编程更加可靠，在真实车间应用中减少人工示教工作量，同时提升安全性和路径质量。
method: 使用 OpenCASCADE 从 CAD 模型中提取焊缝，并将路径节点分类为主端点和辅助安全点。
采用两阶段避障：对短的接近/撤离段进行局部姿态调整，对长的过渡段进行全局重规划。
应用 vanilla ABIT* 结合距离相关的三阶段自适应目标，在引导、障碍物间隙和目标收敛之间进行平衡。
infographic.evidence_signal: 在典型箱体类工件上，该方法将平均路径长度降低了 20%，将最小间隙提高了 8%，并通过重试将实际成功率从 52% 提升到 90.7%。

title: Molten pool dynamic behavior and arc characteristics in laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel
authors: Sen WU, Fei ZHAO, Shuili GONG, Lifeng MA, Haiyan ZHAO, Wei ZHANG
abstract: Invar steel has an extremely low coefficient of thermal expansion, making it widely used in the manufacturing of molds for aerospace composite materials. Most existing studies focus on process aspects, lacking in-depth analysis of the fluid dynamics behavior of the molten pool. Therefore, numerical simulation and high-speed photography were employed to analyze the effects of different process parameters on the molten pool morphology evolution and arc characteristics during laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel, which provides crucial theoretical support for the optimization of the Invar steel welding process. The results indicate that within the laser power range of 5 ~ 6 kW, the increased power leads to greater recoil pressure, which promotes a larger penetration depth and keyhole dimension, intensifies the overall molten pool flow, and makes the arc prone to being attracted by the laser and deflected at a high power. Within the welding speed range of 0.5 ~ 0.8 m/min, a higher speed reduces the heat input, leading to a decreased penetration depth and weld width, and an increased flow velocity and cooling rate of the molten pool; additionally, the arc is prone to deformation at a high speed. Within the welding current range of 150 ~ 170 A, the increased current enhances the arc force, promoting the expansion of weld width and intensifying the molten pool convection; furthermore, the arc is more stable at a high current.

infographic.key_insight: In laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel, higher laser power and welding current deepen and widen the molten pool, while higher travel speed reduces heat input, penetration, and weld width; arc behavior becomes more unstable or deflected at higher power/speed.
infographic.engineering_relevance: These process–fluidity relationships provide practical guidance for tuning hybrid welding parameters to improve weld geometry and arc stability in low-expansion Invar steel applications.
method: Numerical simulation of molten-pool dynamics
High-speed photography of arc and pool behavior
Parameter sweep over laser power, welding speed, and current
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports comparative simulation and high-speed imaging results across laser power (5–6 kW), welding speed (0.5–0.8 m/min), and current (150–170 A), linking each setting to changes in penetration, weld width, flow, and arc shape.
infographic.watch_item: The findings are parameter-window specific, so transfer to different joint geometries, shielding conditions, or machine setups should be validated experimentally before production use.
infographic.paper_title: Molten pool dynamic behavior and arc characteristics in laser-TIG hybrid welding of Invar steel

zh-Hans.title: Invar钢激光-TIG复合焊接中熔池动态行为与电弧特征
zh-Hans.abstract: Invar钢具有极低的热膨胀系数，因此被广泛用于航空航天复合材料模具的制造。现有大多数研究侧重于工艺方面，缺乏对熔池流体动力学行为的深入分析。因此，本文采用数值模拟和高速摄影分析了激光-TIG复合焊接Invar钢过程中，不同工艺参数对熔池形貌演化和电弧特征的影响，为Invar钢焊接工艺优化提供了重要的理论支持。结果表明，在激光功率5 ~ 6 kW范围内，功率增加会导致更大的反冲压力，从而促进更大的熔深和匙孔尺寸，增强整体熔池流动，并使电弧在高功率下更易受到激光吸引而发生偏转。在焊接速度0.5 ~ 0.8 m/min范围内，更高的速度会降低热输入，导致熔深和焊缝宽度减小，同时熔池流速和冷却速率增加；此外，高速度下电弧更容易发生变形。在焊接电流150 ~ 170 A范围内，电流增加会增强电弧力，促进焊缝宽度扩展并强化熔池对流；此外，高电流下电弧更稳定。

infographic.key_insight: 在Invar钢激光-TIG复合焊接中，更高的激光功率和焊接电流会加深并加宽熔池，而更高的行进速度会降低热输入、熔深和焊缝宽度；在更高功率/速度下，电弧行为会变得更不稳定或发生偏转。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这些工艺—流动性关系为调节复合焊接参数以改善低膨胀Invar钢应用中的焊缝几何形貌和电弧稳定性提供了实用指导。
method: 熔池动力学数值模拟
电弧和熔池行为高速摄影
激光功率、焊接速度和电流的参数扫描
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告了在激光功率（5–6 kW）、焊接速度（0.5–0.8 m/min）和电流（150–170 A）条件下的对比模拟和高速成像结果，并将各设定与熔深、焊缝宽度、流动和电弧形状的变化联系起来。

title: Improving the reliability of ultrasonic welding: a hybrid FTA-DEMATEL-EC framework for cost and risk prioritization in mass production
authors: Marián Bujna, Adrián Gula, Chia Kuang Lee
abstract: Our research addresses the limited applicability of traditional reliability assessment methods by implementing a hybrid framework for the Branson 2000X AED ultrasonic welding system in mass production. We aimed to align the quantitative technical framework with the causality and financial impacts of identified failures. This approach created a tool that directly links failure frequency to its systemic causes and economic consequences. To do so, we developed a multi-dimensional hybrid model combining three analytical pillars: quantitative Fault Tree Analysis (FTA) to estimate failure probabilities, the DEMATEL method to uncover hidden causal links, and an Expected Cost (EC) model to prioritize risks based on financial impact rather than failure frequency alone. We found a significant gap between the failure frequencies manufacturers typically report and the actual causes of these failures. While our FTA identified component defects (25.9%) and process instability (24.0%) as the most common issues, our DEMATEL analysis pointed to inefficient maintenance budgeting as the primary root cause. Additionally, our economic model showed that the highest financial risks come not from routine scrap but from human errors during equipment setup and handling, which can lead to catastrophic, costly machine damage. Our results highlight that reliability management with hybrid models requires a dual strategy: rigorous process standardization to reduce scrap and technical measures to prevent low-probability failures that have a large impact on overall reliability. Ultimately, this hybrid framework offers production managers an analytical tool for better resource allocation, an outcome impossible to achieve with traditional standalone tools.
venue: The International Journal of Advanced Manufacturing Technology

infographic.key_insight: A hybrid FTA-DEMATEL-expected-cost framework reveals that the most frequent ultrasonic welding failures are not always the most important drivers of risk or cost.
infographic.engineering_relevance: For mass-production ultrasonic welding, the framework helps engineers prioritize maintenance, setup controls, and process improvements by combining failure probability, causal structure, and financial impact.
method: Fault Tree Analysis estimated failure probabilities for major welding-system failure modes.
DEMATEL identified hidden causal links and exposed root causes behind observed failures.
Expected Cost modeling ranked risks by economic impact rather than frequency alone.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports that component defects (25.9%) and process instability (24.0%) were the most common failures, while inefficient maintenance budgeting emerged as the main root cause and human setup/handling errors produced the highest expected financial losses.
infographic.watch_item: The framework is only as strong as the quality of failure data and cost assumptions, so biased reporting or incomplete cost modeling could distort prioritization.
infographic.paper_title: Improving the reliability of ultrasonic welding: a hybrid FTA-DEMATEL-EC framework for cost and risk prioritization in mass production

zh-Hans.title: 提高超声波焊接的可靠性：一种用于大规模生产中成本与风险优先级排序的混合FTA-DEMATEL-EC框架
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究针对传统可靠性评估方法适用性有限的问题，针对批量生产中的 Branson 2000X AED 超声波焊接系统实施了一种混合框架。我们的目标是使定量技术框架与所识别故障的因果关系及财务影响相一致。该方法创建了一个工具，可直接将故障频率与其系统性原因和经济后果联系起来。为此，我们开发了一种多维混合模型，结合了三个分析支柱：用于估计故障概率的定量故障树分析（FTA）、用于揭示隐藏因果联系的 DEMATEL 方法，以及基于经济影响而非仅凭故障频率来对风险进行优先级排序的期望成本（EC）模型。我们发现，制造商通常报告的故障频率与这些故障的实际原因之间存在显著差距。虽然我们的 FTA 识别出部件缺陷（25.9%）和工艺不稳定（24.0%）是最常见的问题，但我们的 DEMATEL 分析指出，低效的维护预算编制是主要根本原因。此外，我们的经济模型表明，最高的财务风险并非来自常规报废，而是来自设备设置和搬运过程中的人为错误，这些错误可能导致灾难性且代价高昂的机器损坏。我们的结果强调，采用混合模型的可靠性管理需要双重策略：通过严格的过程标准化来减少报废，并通过技术措施防止概率低但对整体可靠性影响巨大的故障。最终，该混合框架为生产管理者提供了一个用于更好分配资源的分析工具，这是传统单一工具无法实现的。

infographic.key_insight: 混合的 FTA-DEMATEL-期望成本框架揭示，超声波焊接中最频繁的故障并不总是风险或成本的最重要驱动因素。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 对于大规模生产的超声波焊接，该框架通过结合故障概率、因果结构和财务影响，帮助工程师优先安排维护、设置控制和工艺改进。
method: 故障树分析估计了主要焊接系统失效模式的故障概率。
DEMATEL 识别了隐藏的因果联系，并揭示了已观察故障背后的根本原因。
期望成本建模依据经济影响而非仅凭频率对风险进行排序。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告称，部件缺陷（25.9%）和工艺不稳定（24.0%）是最常见的故障，而低效的维护预算编制是主要根本原因，设备设置/搬运中的人为错误则造成了最高的预期财务损失。
infographic.watch_item: 该框架的有效性取决于故障数据和成本假设的质量，因此有偏差的报告或不完整的成本建模可能会扭曲优先级排序。

title: Microstructure and wear properties of Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings sprayed by conventional and supersonic high-velocity atmospheric plasma spraying with axial powder feeding
authors: Tadeusz Kubaszek, Anita Słyś, Marek Góral, Marcin Drajewicz, Kamil Gancarczyk
abstract: This study investigated the microstructural evolution and phase transformation mechanisms in Cr₃C₂-NiCr cermet coatings (Metco 5241 powder) plasma-sprayed onto S235 steel substrates.Two technologies were used: conventional atmospheric plasma spraying (APS) with radial powder injection (single-electrode A60 torch) and supersonic plasma spraying with axial powder feeding (HV-APS, three-electrode Axial III torch).The HV-APS coatings exhibited nearly halved porosity (6.16% vs. 11.99% for APS) and significantly higher microhardness (1141 HV0.2 vs. 897 HV0.2).Phase analysis revealed the disappearance of primary Cr 3 C 2 and Cr 21.26 Ni 1.74 C 6 carbides in favour of supersaturated Cr-Ni solid solutions.In the erosion tests conducted at a 90° impact angle, the two coating variants exhibited nearly identical specific erosion rates (0.20 mg/g for APS and 0.19 mg/g for HV-APS) and comparable damage mechanisms, dominated by fatigue-driven lamellar spalling and brittle fracture.However, in tribological tests (ball-on-disc, 30 N load), HV-APS coatings showed nearly 27% lower wear volume (2.85 mm 3 ) and a reduced specific wear rate (1.90 × 10 -4 mm 3 /Nm) compared to APS (3.90 mm 3 and 2.60 × 10 -4 mm 3 /Nm, respectively), correlating with their higher density and hardness.The obtained results confirm that the use of axial powder feeding in supersonic HV-APS plasma spraying significantly improves the mechanical and tribological properties of Cr₃C₂-NiCr coatings, although this advantage is not evident in the erosion tests at high impact angles.
venue: Advances in Science and Technology – Research Journal

infographic.key_insight: Supersonic HV-APS with axial powder feeding produces denser, harder Cr3C2–NiCr coatings than conventional APS, but this mainly improves wear resistance rather than high-angle erosion resistance.
infographic.engineering_relevance: For wear-prone components, switching to axial-feed HV-APS can improve coating performance without changing the coating chemistry, making it a practical route to extend service life.
method: Compared conventional APS (radial powder injection, A60 torch) with HV-APS (axial powder feeding, Axial III torch).
Deposited Cr3C2–NiCr cermet coatings on S235 steel and analyzed microstructure, phase composition, hardness, porosity, erosion, and tribology.
Evaluated performance using erosion testing at 90° impact and ball-on-disc wear testing under 30 N load.
infographic.evidence_signal: HV-APS reduced porosity from 11.99% to 6.16% and increased microhardness from 897 HV0.2 to 1141 HV0.2, while lowering wear volume from 3.90 to 2.85 mm3; erosion rates remained nearly unchanged (0.20 vs 0.19 mg/g).
infographic.watch_item: The HV-APS advantage did not translate into better erosion resistance at 90° impact, so process selection should be based on the dominant service wear mode.
infographic.paper_title: Microstructure and wear properties of Cr₃C₂–NiCr coatings sprayed by conventional and supersonic high-velocity atmospheric plasma spraying with axial powder feeding

zh-Hans.title: 采用常规与超音速高速大气等离子喷涂轴向送粉制备的Cr₃C₂–NiCr涂层的显微组织与磨损性能
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了喷涂于S235钢基体上的Cr₃C₂-NiCr金属陶瓷涂层（Metco 5241粉末）的显微组织演变和相变机理。采用了两种技术：带径向送粉的常规大气等离子喷涂（APS，单电极A60喷枪）以及带轴向送粉的超音速等离子喷涂（HV-APS，三电极Axial III喷枪）。HV-APS涂层的孔隙率几乎减半（6.16%，而APS为11.99%），显微硬度显著更高（1141 HV0.2，而APS为897 HV0.2）。相分析表明，初生Cr 3 C 2 和Cr 21.26 Ni 1.74 C 6 碳化物消失，转而形成过饱和Cr-Ni固溶体。在90°冲蚀角条件下进行的冲蚀试验中，两种涂层的比冲蚀率几乎相同（APS为0.20 mg/g，HV-APS为0.19 mg/g），且损伤机理相近，以疲劳驱动的层片剥落和脆性断裂为主。然而，在摩擦学试验（球-盘，30 N载荷）中，与APS相比，HV-APS涂层的磨损体积几乎降低27%（2.85 mm 3），比磨损率也更低（1.90 × 10 -4 mm 3 /Nm）；APS分别为3.90 mm 3 和2.60 × 10 -4 mm 3 /Nm，这与其更高的致密度和硬度相关。所获结果证实，在超音速HV-APS等离子喷涂中采用轴向送粉可显著改善Cr₃C₂-NiCr涂层的力学和摩擦学性能，尽管这一优势在高冲击角冲蚀试验中并不明显。

infographic.key_insight: 采用轴向送粉的超音速HV-APS制备的Cr3C2–NiCr涂层比常规APS更致密、更硬，但这种改善主要体现在耐磨性上，而非高角度冲蚀抗力上。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 对于易磨损部件，在不改变涂层化学成分的情况下改用轴向送粉HV-APS可提升涂层性能，是延长服役寿命的一种实用途径。
method: 比较了常规APS（径向送粉，A60喷枪）与HV-APS（轴向送粉，Axial III喷枪）。
在S235钢上沉积Cr3C2–NiCr金属陶瓷涂层，并分析其显微组织、相组成、硬度、孔隙率、冲蚀和摩擦学性能。
采用90°冲击冲蚀试验和30 N载荷下的球-盘磨损试验评估性能。
infographic.evidence_signal: HV-APS将孔隙率从11.99%降至6.16%，并将显微硬度从897 HV0.2提高到1141 HV0.2，同时将磨损体积从3.90降至2.85 mm3；冲蚀率则几乎未变（0.20 vs 0.19 mg/g）。
infographic.watch_item: HV-APS的优势并未转化为90°冲击条件下更好的抗冲蚀性能，因此工艺选择应依据主导服役磨损模式。

title: Development of a Method for Producing Self-Fluxing Nickel-Based Coatings by Detonation Spraying
authors: Dastan Buitkenov, Laila Sulyubayeva, Daryn Baizhan, Nurmakhanbet Raisov, Nurkhat Bimakhan
abstract: This study investigated the influence of detonation spraying parameters on the structure and tribological and mechanical properties of self-fluxing coatings of the Ni–Cr–Fe–B–Si–C system. The investigated parameters included the barrel filling level (48–68%), the molar ratio of the working gases (O/C = 1.026–1.856), and the inter-shot delay (0–1 s). Morphological analysis of the coatings revealed a characteristic lamellar structure and a dependence of coating thickness and defect formation on the spraying conditions. A lower barrel filling level resulted in a denser coating structure with minimal porosity, whereas medium and high filling levels promoted the formation of microcracks, presumably due to increased residual stresses. Tribological tests showed that the minimum coefficient of friction was obtained at a barrel filling level of 48% (μ = 0.674 ± 0.136) and an O/C ratio of 1.026, but these conditions were also associated with increased wear. The highest wear resistance was obtained at an O/C ratio of 1.856 and an increased inter-shot delay of up to 1 s, resulting in a decrease in the specific wear rate to 0.000189 mm³/(N·m). Roughness analysis showed that increasing the inter-shot delay reduced Ra from 5.00 to 3.60 μm, which may be attributed to a reduction in thermal load and more favorable coating formation conditions. The maximum hardness, up to 905.6 HV, was obtained for a combination of parameters that promoted the formation of a dense structure and strengthening phases. The results indicate that optimizing the detonation spraying parameters requires a trade-off between reducing the coefficient of friction and increasing wear resistance. The findings can be used to develop tech nologies for the restoration and surface strengthening of machine components.
venue: Bulletin of the Karaganda University Physics Series

infographic.key_insight: Detonation-sprayed self-fluxing Ni–Cr–Fe–B–Si–C coatings can be tuned from low-friction to high-wear-resistance behavior by adjusting barrel filling, gas ratio, and inter-shot delay.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The results provide a process window for restoring and hardening machine parts with coatings whose density, hardness, roughness, and tribology can be traded off for the target service condition.
method: Varied barrel filling level from 48–68%
Adjusted working-gas molar ratio (O/C = 1.026–1.856)
Changed inter-shot delay from 0–1 s during detonation spraying
infographic.evidence_signal: Evaluation combined microstructural inspection, roughness measurement, hardness testing, and tribological tests; best wear rate reached 0.000189 mm³/(N·m), while minimum friction was μ = 0.674 ± 0.136.
infographic.watch_item: Optimizing for friction reduction and optimizing for wear resistance do not occur under the same spray settings, so process selection must match the intended operating load.
infographic.paper_title: Development of a Method for Producing Self-Fluxing Nickel-Based Coatings by Detonation Spraying

zh-Hans.title: 通过爆炸喷涂制备自熔性镍基涂层的方法开发
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了爆炸喷涂参数对 Ni–Cr–Fe–B–Si–C 体系自熔性涂层结构以及摩擦学和力学性能的影响。所研究的参数包括炮管填充率（48–68%）、工作气体摩尔比（O/C = 1.026–1.856）以及两次发射间隔（0–1 s）。对涂层的形貌分析表明，涂层具有典型的层状结构，且涂层厚度和缺陷形成依赖于喷涂条件。较低的炮管填充率可获得更致密、孔隙率更低的涂层结构，而中等和较高填充率则促进微裂纹形成，推测这与残余应力增大有关。摩擦学测试表明，在炮管填充率为 48%（μ = 0.674 ± 0.136）且 O/C 比为 1.026 时获得了最低摩擦系数，但这些条件也伴随着磨损增加。在 O/C 比为 1.856 且两次发射间隔增至 1 s 时获得了最高耐磨性，使比磨损率降至 0.000189 mm³/(N·m)。粗糙度分析表明，增加两次发射间隔可使 Ra 从 5.00 降至 3.60 μm，这可能归因于热负荷降低以及更有利的涂层形成条件。在有利于致密结构和强化相形成的一组参数组合下，获得了最高硬度，最高可达 905.6 HV。结果表明，优化爆炸喷涂参数需要在降低摩擦系数与提高耐磨性之间进行权衡。这些发现可用于开发用于机械零件修复和表面强化的技术。

infographic.key_insight: 通过调整炮管填充率、气体比和两次发射间隔，爆炸喷涂自熔性 Ni–Cr–Fe–B–Si–C 涂层可在低摩擦与高耐磨行为之间进行调控。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 这些结果为采用涂层修复和强化机械零件提供了工艺窗口；涂层的致密性、硬度、粗糙度和摩擦学性能可根据目标服役工况进行权衡。
method: 将炮管填充率从 48–68% 进行变化
调整工作气体摩尔比（O/C = 1.026–1.856）
在爆炸喷涂过程中将两次发射间隔从 0–1 s 进行改变
infographic.evidence_signal: 评估结合了微观结构观察、粗糙度测量、硬度测试和摩擦学测试；最佳磨损率达到 0.000189 mm³/(N·m)，而最低摩擦系数为 μ = 0.674 ± 0.136。
infographic.watch_item: 面向降低摩擦的优化与面向提高耐磨性的优化并不会出现在相同喷涂参数下，因此工艺选择必须与预期服役载荷相匹配。

title: A Comparative Analysis of Multitask Neural Networks and Stacking Ensemble Learning for Predicting UTS, Weld Hardness, and HAZ Hardness in Welding Applications
authors: Sama Mukhtar, Amit Sata, Gaurang Joshi, Durgesh Srivastava
abstract: Accurately predicting welding performance measures like ultimate strength (UTS), weld bead hardness, and HAZ mechanical hardness is crucial for ensuring the structural integrity and performance of welded components. Multitask learning (MTL) refers to a machine learning approach in which one model is designed to handle several interconnected tasks at the same time. Instead of training separate models for each task, MTL shares representations among tasks, allowing them to leverage common patterns while maintaining task-specific distinctions. In this study, we compared two advanced machine learning techniques, namely multitask neural network (MTNN) and stacking ensemble learning, for predicting these parameters based on a shared dataset. A multitask neural network (MTNN) is a specific type of multitask learning (MTL) model that uses a deep neural network architecture to handle multiple related tasks simultaneously. In MTNN, different tasks share some hidden layers while having task-specific output layers. This shared representation allows the model to learn common patterns across tasks while maintaining task-specific outputs. Both methods are evaluated using RMSE and R<sup>2</sup> to determine their predictive accuracy and overall effectiveness. It showed robust prediction strength, as its RMSE outcomes are 0.1288 for UTS, 0.0886 for weld hardness, and 0.1125 for HAZ hardness, whereas R<sup>2</sup> values are 0.6724, 0.9215, and 0.8407, respectively. This underlines that it can generalize well in interrelated tasks. Stacking ensemble learning outperformed MTL in the accuracy of individual tasks: the RMSE for UTS is 0.0263 and R<sup>2</sup> is 0.9863; for weld hardness, it is 0.0467 and 0.9782; and for HAZ hardness, it is 0.1109 and 0.8453. Such results indicate the good ability of ensemble methods to produce highly accurate, task-specific predictions. This comparison reveals the trade-offs between the two approaches. MTL is good in scenarios where the tasks are related and the data are sparse, giving efficient training and good generalization; stacking ensembles work better in the case of accurate, independent predictions. In both cases, they show remarkable potential for improving the predictive power of welding applications, making them suitable precursors to further investigation into hybrid models that bring the best features of both approaches together.

infographic.key_insight: Stacking ensemble learning predicted welding quality metrics more accurately than the multitask neural network, while multitask learning still offered strong shared-task generalization.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The study helps welding engineers choose between shared-model efficiency and task-specific accuracy when estimating UTS, weld hardness, and HAZ hardness for process optimization and quality control.
method: Built a multitask neural network with shared hidden layers and task-specific outputs.
Compared it against stacking ensemble learning on the same welding dataset.
Evaluated both models using RMSE and R² across UTS, weld hardness, and HAZ hardness.
infographic.evidence_signal: On the reported test results, stacking achieved lower RMSE and higher R² for all three targets, with especially strong performance for UTS and weld hardness.
infographic.watch_item: The performance trade-off suggests stacking may be more accurate for individual outputs, but MTL may be preferable when data are limited or tasks are strongly related; results may not transfer without validation on new welding conditions.
infographic.paper_title: A Comparative Analysis of Multitask Neural Networks and Stacking Ensemble Learning for Predicting UTS, Weld Hardness, and HAZ Hardness in Welding Applications

zh-Hans.title: 焊接应用中用于预测UTS、焊缝硬度和HAZ硬度的多任务神经网络与堆叠集成学习比较分析
zh-Hans.abstract: 准确预测焊接性能指标，如极限强度（UTS）、焊缝硬度和HAZ力学硬度，对于确保焊接构件的结构完整性和性能至关重要。多任务学习（MTL）是一种机器学习方法，其中一个模型被设计用于同时处理多个相互关联的任务。与针对每个任务分别训练独立模型不同，MTL在任务之间共享表示，使其能够利用共同模式，同时保持任务特定差异。本研究基于共享数据集，对两种先进机器学习技术，即多任务神经网络（MTNN）和堆叠集成学习，用于预测这些参数进行了比较。多任务神经网络（MTNN）是一种特定类型的多任务学习（MTL）模型，采用深度神经网络架构同时处理多个相关任务。在MTNN中，不同任务共享部分隐藏层，同时具有任务特定的输出层。这种共享表示使模型能够学习跨任务的共同模式，同时保持任务特定输出。两种方法均采用RMSE和R<sup>2</sup>进行评估，以确定其预测精度和整体有效性。结果表明其具有稳健的预测能力，其RMSE分别为UTS 0.1288、焊缝硬度0.0886、HAZ硬度0.1125，而R<sup>2</sup>值分别为0.6724、0.9215和0.8407。这说明它能够在相互关联的任务中实现良好的泛化能力。堆叠集成学习在各个单独任务的精度上优于MTL：UTS的RMSE为0.0263、R<sup>2</sup>为0.9863；焊缝硬度的RMSE为0.0467、R<sup>2</sup>为0.9782；HAZ硬度的RMSE为0.1109、R<sup>2</sup>为0.8453。这些结果表明，集成方法具有产生高精度、任务特定预测的良好能力。该比较揭示了两种方法之间的权衡。MTL适用于任务相关且数据稀缺的场景，能够实现高效训练和良好泛化；堆叠集成在需要准确、独立预测的情况下表现更佳。两种方法都显示出提升焊接应用预测能力的显著潜力，使其适合作为进一步研究混合模型的前导，这类模型可将两种方法的最佳特性结合起来。

infographic.key_insight: 堆叠集成学习对焊接质量指标的预测比多任务神经网络更准确，而多任务学习仍提供了较强的共享任务泛化能力。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该研究有助于焊接工程师在估计UTS、焊缝硬度和HAZ硬度时，在共享模型效率与任务特定精度之间作出选择，以支持工艺优化和质量控制。
method: 构建了一个具有共享隐藏层和任务特定输出的多任务神经网络。
在相同的焊接数据集上将其与堆叠集成学习进行比较。
使用RMSE和R²在UTS、焊缝硬度和HAZ硬度上评估两种模型。
infographic.evidence_signal: 在报告的测试结果中，堆叠方法在三个目标上均取得了更低的RMSE和更高的R²，尤其在UTS和焊缝硬度方面表现突出。
infographic.watch_item: 这种性能权衡表明，堆叠方法可能更适合单个输出的高精度预测，但当数据有限或任务高度相关时，MTL可能更适合；未经在新的焊接条件下验证时，结果可能无法直接迁移。

title: Long-term corrosion behaviors and wear behavior of Fe-based amorphous coatings in different humidity environments
authors: Shuai Cui, Haimin Zhai, Zihan Feng, Xuqiang Li, Wensheng Li, Xiangjuan Fan
abstract: Fe-based amorphous coatings (Fe-based AMCs) were successfully prepared on Q235 carbon steel by detonation spray under different spraying parameters. The corrosion and tribology behaviors of coatings were systematically tested. The droplets show disk-like morphology with the highest circularity and expansion factor, which is crucial to reduce the defects of coatings and to form fine-lamellar-structures coatings with dense microstructure. A higher incidence of porosity defects in the coating is associated with reduced long-term corrosion resistance. Moreover, the tribo-chemical reactions between Si3N4 balls and water molecules play a significant role in wear behaviors for coating in different humidity conditions. The friction coefficient and wear rate of coatings decrease as the humidity conditions increase.

infographic.key_insight: Detonation-sprayed Fe-based amorphous coatings achieve better long-term corrosion and wear performance when spray conditions produce disk-like droplets, dense lamellar microstructures, and low porosity.
infographic.engineering_relevance: Optimizing spraying parameters to minimize defects can improve durability of steel components exposed to humid environments and combined corrosion-wear service.
method: Detonation spray Fe-based amorphous coatings onto Q235 carbon steel under varied process parameters.
Characterize droplet morphology and coating microstructure, including circularity, expansion factor, and porosity.
Evaluate long-term corrosion behavior and tribological performance under different humidity conditions.
infographic.evidence_signal: The abstract reports systematic corrosion and tribology testing and links higher porosity to poorer corrosion resistance, while increasing humidity lowers friction coefficient and wear rate.
infographic.watch_item: Results may depend strongly on spray parameter control and humidity environment, so performance should not be assumed without matching service conditions.
infographic.paper_title: Long-term corrosion behaviors and wear behavior of Fe-based amorphous coatings in different humidity environments

zh-Hans.title: 不同湿度环境下Fe基非晶涂层的长期腐蚀行为与磨损行为
zh-Hans.abstract: 通过爆炸喷涂在Q235碳钢上成功制备了不同喷涂参数下的Fe基非晶涂层（Fe-based AMCs）。系统测试了涂层的腐蚀与摩擦学行为。液滴呈盘状形貌，具有最高的圆度和铺展因子，这对于减少涂层缺陷、形成具有致密微观结构的细层片状结构涂层至关重要。涂层中孔隙缺陷发生率较高与长期耐腐蚀性降低有关。此外，在不同湿度条件下，Si3N4球与水分子之间的摩擦化学反应对涂层的磨损行为起着重要作用。随着湿度条件升高，涂层的摩擦系数和磨损率降低。

infographic.key_insight: 当喷涂条件形成盘状液滴、致密层片微观结构且孔隙率较低时，爆炸喷涂Fe基非晶涂层可获得更好的长期耐腐蚀和耐磨性能。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 优化喷涂参数以尽量减少缺陷，可提高暴露于潮湿环境及腐蚀-磨损耦合服役条件下钢构件的耐久性。
method: 在不同工艺参数下，将Fe基非晶涂层通过爆炸喷涂沉积到Q235碳钢上。
表征液滴形貌和涂层微观结构，包括圆度、铺展因子和孔隙率。
在不同湿度条件下评估长期腐蚀行为和摩擦学性能。
infographic.evidence_signal: 摘要报告了系统的腐蚀与摩擦学测试，并指出较高孔隙率与较差的耐腐蚀性相关，而湿度升高会降低摩擦系数和磨损率。
infographic.watch_item: 结果可能强烈依赖喷涂参数控制和湿度环境，因此在未匹配服役条件时不应直接假定其性能。

title: EFFECT OF FLAME-SPRAYING TEMPERATURE ON THE PROPERTIES OF Ni–Cr–B–Si-BASED SELF-FLUXING COATINGS
authors: Dastan Buitkenov, Manarbek Kylyshkanov, Daryn Baizhan, Nurmakhanbet Raisov, Nurkhat Bimakhan
abstract: The present study investigates the effect of flame-spraying process parameters on the microstructure and mechanical properties of Ni–Cr–B–Si-based self-fluxing coatings. Corrosion-resistant AISI 321 austenitic chromium–nickel steel was used as the substrate material. The coatings were deposited by flame spraying using a Metal Coat 6PM-II system. To vary the thermal conditions of the spraying process, the oxygen-to-acetylene (O₂/C₂H₂) ratio was adjusted to 1.0, 1.1, and 1.2. The spraying parameters were monitored using an Accuraspray 4.0 diagnostic system. The resulting coatings were characterized in terms of microstructure, porosity, microhardness, surface roughness, and adhesion strength. Increasing the O₂/C₂H₂ ratio resulted in densification of the coating structure and a decrease in porosity from 1.97 ± 0.13% to 0.90 ± 0.09%. Concurrently, the surface roughness decreased from 4.70 ± 0.09 μm to 2.99 ± 0.11 μm, while the adhesion strength increased from 22.14 ± 4.3 MPa to 35.02 ± 3.9 MPa. The highest average microhardness of 1051.7 HV was obtained at an O₂/C₂H₂ ratio of 1.1. Among the investigated spraying conditions, the coating produced at O₂/C₂H₂ = 1.2 exhibited the lowest porosity and surface roughness together with the highest adhesion strength. The results demonstrate that controlling the O₂/C₂H₂ ratio provides an effective means of tailoring the microstructural and mechanical characteristics of flame-sprayed Ni–Cr–B–Si-based self-fluxing coatings.

zh-Hans.title: 火焰喷涂温度对 Ni–Cr–B–Si 基自熔性涂层性能的影响
zh-Hans.abstract: 本研究考察了火焰喷涂工艺参数对 Ni–Cr–B–Si 基自熔性涂层微观结构和力学性能的影响。采用耐腐蚀的 AISI 321 奥氏体铬镍钢作为基体材料。涂层通过使用 Metal Coat 6PM-II 系统进行火焰喷涂沉积。为改变喷涂过程的热条件，将氧-乙炔（O₂/C₂H₂）比调整为 1.0、1.1 和 1.2。喷涂参数通过 Accuraspray 4.0 诊断系统进行监测。对所得涂层的微观结构、孔隙率、显微硬度、表面粗糙度和结合强度进行了表征。提高 O₂/C₂H₂ 比使涂层结构致密化，孔隙率从 1.97 ± 0.13% 降至 0.90 ± 0.09%。同时，表面粗糙度从 4.70 ± 0.09 μm 降至 2.99 ± 0.11 μm，而结合强度从 22.14 ± 4.3 MPa 增至 35.02 ± 3.9 MPa。在 O₂/C₂H₂ 比为 1.1 时获得了最高平均显微硬度 1051.7 HV。在所研究的喷涂条件中，O₂/C₂H₂ = 1.2 制备的涂层表现出最低的孔隙率和表面粗糙度，同时具有最高的结合强度。结果表明，控制 O₂/C₂H₂ 比为调控火焰喷涂 Ni–Cr–B–Si 基自熔性涂层微观结构和力学特性的有效手段。

infographic.key_insight: 提高火焰喷涂 O₂/C₂H₂ 比使 Ni–Cr–B–Si 自熔性涂层更加致密，降低孔隙率和粗糙度并提高结合强度，而最高显微硬度出现在 1.1。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 工艺气体比例调节为优化火焰喷涂涂层质量、用于 AISI 321 钢耐磨和耐腐蚀表面的实际手段。
method: 使用 Metal Coat 6PM-II 系统将 Ni–Cr–B–Si 涂层火焰喷涂到 AISI 321 不锈钢上。
将 O₂/C₂H₂ 比分别设为 1.0、1.1 和 1.2，并使用 Accuraspray 4.0 监测喷涂条件。
测量微观结构、孔隙率、显微硬度、表面粗糙度和结合强度。

title: Biomaterials and biomechanical design of distal weight-bearing implants: Computational modeling, biomaterial interfaces, and clinical translation
authors: Muntadher Saleh Mahdi, Ayad M. Takhakh, Mohamed Hamdy Doweidar
abstract: Distal Weight-Bearing Implants (DWBIs) represent a clinically emerging class of load-bearing medical devices in which biomaterial design, surface architecture, and biomechanical performance are tightly coupled. Their success depends not only on restoring distal support in transfemoral rehabilitation, but also on the ability of metallic, ceramic, and composite biomaterial interfaces to sustain cyclic loading while promoting durable bone-implant integration. However, distal support also changes bending moments, shear stresses, micromotion, coating durability, and biological demands at the bone–implant interface. This systematic review synthesizes DWBI concepts, geometry optimization, finite element analysis with gait-phase loading, Functionally Graded Materials (FGMs), graded Ti–HAp (hydroxyapatite) architectures, in-vivo osseointegration evidence, and clinical translation pathways. A quantitative trend analysis was performed on 34 direct-contribution papers and 32 empirical studies to assess trends, validation depth, and translation readiness. However, more than half of the empirical evidence remained at the bench or simulation level, while animal and human/clinical studies formed a smaller validation layer. HAp-centered surface or bulk material engineering represented a substantial share of the corpus; however, evidence for graded Ti–HAp/FGM architectures was derived predominantly from non-DWBI biomaterial and mechanistic analog studies, supporting mechanistic plausibility rather than DWBI-specific validation. Mechanistically, DWBI should be interpreted as an integrated biomaterial-mechanical system linking macro-geometry, metallic/ceramic surface architecture, graded Ti-HAp interfaces, gait-phase loading, tribology/corrosion behavior, in-vivo fixation, and clinical workflow. Translation will require patient-realistic loading conditions, validated finite element analysis workflows, device-level fatigue and coating-integrity testing, standardized in-vivo endpoints, harmonized rehabilitation protocols, and registry-supported clinical follow-up linking mechanical plausibility to durable biological fixation and patient-level benefit.

infographic.key_insight: Distal weight-bearing implants work as coupled biomechanical-material systems, where geometry, graded biomaterial interfaces, and gait-phase loading must be co-designed to preserve fixation and support osseointegration.
infographic.engineering_relevance: For implant engineers, the main design challenge is balancing distal load transfer with low micromotion, coating durability, and fatigue resistance under realistic cyclic walking loads.
method: Systematic review of DWBI design, biomaterial interfaces, and clinical translation

infographic.evidence_signal: The evidence base is still mostly bench- and simulation-level, with fewer animal and human studies, and graded Ti-HAp support is largely indirect rather than DWBI-specific.
infographic.watch_item: Clinical translation depends on validated patient-realistic loading, coating-integrity/fatigue testing, and standardized in-vivo endpoints; otherwise, mechanistic plausibility may not translate to durable fixation.

zh-Hans.title: 远端承重植入物的生物材料与生物力学设计：计算建模、生物材料界面与临床转化
zh-Hans.abstract: 远端承重植入物（Distal Weight-Bearing Implants, DWBIs）代表一类临床上新兴的承载型医疗器械，其生物材料设计、表面结构与生物力学性能高度耦合。其成功不仅取决于在股骨截肢后康复中恢复远端支撑的能力，也取决于金属、陶瓷和复合生物材料界面在促进持久骨-植入物整合的同时承受循环载荷的能力。然而，远端支撑也会改变弯矩、剪应力、微动、涂层耐久性以及骨-植入物界面的生物学需求。本系统综述整合了DWBI概念、几何优化、结合步态阶段载荷的有限元分析、功能梯度材料（Functionally Graded Materials, FGMs）、梯度Ti–HAp（羟基磷灰石）结构、体内骨整合证据以及临床转化路径。我们对34篇直接贡献论文和32项实证研究进行了定量趋势分析，以评估研究趋势、验证深度和转化就绪度。然而，超过半数的实证证据仍停留在台架或仿真层面，而动物和人体/临床研究仅构成较小的验证层。以HAp为中心的表面或体相材料工程在整体文献中占据相当比例；然而，关于梯度Ti–HAp/FGM结构的证据主要来自非DWBI生物材料和机理类比研究，因此支持的是机理上的可行性，而非DWBI特异性的验证。从机理上看，DWBI应被理解为一个集成的生物材料-力学系统，连接宏观几何、金属/陶瓷表面结构、梯度Ti-HAp界面、步态阶段载荷、摩擦学/腐蚀行为、体内固定以及临床流程。其转化将要求患者真实负载条件、经过验证的有限元分析工作流程、器械层面的疲劳与涂层完整性测试、标准化体内终点评估、统一的康复方案，以及由注册系统支持的临床随访，以将力学上的可行性与持久的生物固定和患者层面的获益联系起来。

infographic.key_insight: 远端承重植入物作为耦合的生物力学-材料系统运行，其中几何形态、梯度生物材料界面和步态阶段载荷必须协同设计，以维持固定并促进骨整合。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 对于植入物工程师而言，主要设计挑战是在真实循环步行载荷下平衡远端载荷传递、低微动、涂层耐久性和疲劳抗性。
method: 对DWBI设计、生物材料界面和临床转化进行系统综述
对34篇直接贡献论文和32项实证研究进行趋势分析
综合有限元建模、FGM/梯度Ti-HAp概念和体内证据
infographic.evidence_signal: 证据基础仍主要来自台架和仿真层面，动物和人体研究较少，而梯度Ti-HAp支持大多为间接证据，而非DWBI特异性证据。
infographic.watch_item: 临床转化取决于经过验证的患者真实载荷、涂层完整性/疲劳测试以及标准化体内终点；否则，机理上的可行性可能无法转化为持久固定。

title: Enhancing weld performance of AA2024-T351 using drilled-to-bossed geometry and deep learning prediction in direct drive friction welding
authors: Eyob Messele Sefene, Alemayehu Admas Abay, Akshansh Mishra, Assefa Asmare Tsegaw, William Gomez, Addisalem Desalegn Sisay
abstract: Abstract The growing demand for lightweight, high-strength materials in the aerospace and automotive industries has brought aluminium alloys such as AA2024-T351 into the spotlight due to their outstanding strength-to-weight ratio. However, achieving reliable joints in such alloys remains a significant challenge, particularly when using conventional welding techniques. To address this, the present study focuses on optimizing process parameters in Direct Drive Friction Welding (DDFW) for AA2024-T351. A novel drilled-to-bossed geometry, inspired by the traditional mortise-and-tenon joint, is introduced to enhance mechanical interlocking and improve weld integrity. Experimental trials were systematically designed using an L18 orthogonal array to evaluate both tensile and torsional strength. The experiments were conducted on a customized engine lathe, with friction pressure, forging pressure, spindle speed, faying surface geometry, and friction time selected as the controllable process parameters. In parallel, advanced deep learning models, including an ensemble residual network, a compact attention network, and an adaptive multiscale network, were implemented to predict ultimate tensile strength based on the welding conditions. The results revealed that the optimal parameter combination of 30 MPa friction pressure, 70 MPa forging pressure, 2200 rpm spindle speed, drilled-to-bossed geometry, and 4 min of friction time yielded exceptional mechanical performance, achieving a tensile strength of 538 MPa and torsional strength of 325 MPa. The drilled-to-bossed configuration demonstrated significantly higher joint strength compared to conventional flat-to-flat joints. Moreover, among the deep learning models, the ensemble residual network achieved the highest predictive accuracy with an R² value of approximately 0.81, effectively capturing the complex relationship between process parameters and weld strength.

infographic.key_insight: A drilled-to-bossed joint geometry combined with optimized direct drive friction welding parameters substantially improves AA2024-T351 weld strength, while deep learning can predict tensile performance from process settings.
infographic.engineering_relevance: The study offers a practical route to stronger, more reliable lightweight aluminum joints for aerospace and automotive applications by coupling mechanical design with data-driven process optimization.
method: L18 orthogonal-array experiments on AA2024-T351 DDFW
Compared friction pressure, forging pressure, spindle speed, faying-surface geometry, and friction time
Trained deep learning models to predict ultimate tensile strength
infographic.evidence_signal: Under the best setting, the weld reached 538 MPa tensile strength and 325 MPa torsional strength, and the ensemble residual network achieved the strongest prediction performance with R² ≈ 0.81.
infographic.watch_item: The dataset appears limited to an L18 experimental design, so model generalization and transfer to other alloys, geometries, or welding setups may need further validation.
infographic.paper_title: Enhancing weld performance of AA2024-T351 using drilled-to-bossed geometry and deep learning prediction in direct drive friction welding

zh-Hans.title: 采用钻孔凸台几何与深度学习预测提升AA2024-T351在直接驱动摩擦焊中的焊接性能
zh-Hans.abstract: 摘要 随着航空航天和汽车工业对轻质高强材料需求的不断增长，铝合金如AA2024-T351因其优异的强度重量比而备受关注。然而，在此类合金中实现可靠接头仍然是一项重大挑战，尤其是在采用传统焊接技术时。为此，本研究聚焦于优化AA2024-T351直接驱动摩擦焊（DDFW）的工艺参数。研究引入了一种受传统榫卯接头启发的新型钻孔凸台几何，以增强机械互锁并改善焊接完整性。采用L18正交数组系统地设计实验，以评估拉伸强度和扭转强度。实验在一台定制发动机车床上进行，摩擦压力、镦粗压力、主轴转速、结合面几何形状和摩擦时间被选为可控工艺参数。与此同时，采用先进的深度学习模型，包括集成残差网络、紧凑注意力网络和自适应多尺度网络，根据焊接条件预测极限抗拉强度。结果表明，30 MPa摩擦压力、70 MPa镦粗压力、2200 rpm主轴转速、钻孔凸台几何以及4 min摩擦时间的最优参数组合产生了卓越的力学性能，获得了538 MPa的抗拉强度和325 MPa的扭转强度。与传统平面对平面接头相比，钻孔凸台结构表现出显著更高的接头强度。此外，在深度学习模型中，集成残差网络取得了最高的预测精度，R²值约为0.81，能够有效捕捉工艺参数与焊接强度之间的复杂关系。

infographic.key_insight: 钻孔凸台接头几何结合优化的直接驱动摩擦焊参数，可显著提升AA2024-T351焊接强度，同时深度学习能够根据工艺设定预测抗拉性能。
infographic.engineering_relevance: 该研究通过将机械设计与数据驱动的工艺优化相结合，为航空航天和汽车应用中的高强度、更可靠轻质铝接头提供了一条实用途径。
method: 针对AA2024-T351直接驱动摩擦焊开展L18正交数组实验
比较摩擦压力、镦粗压力、主轴转速、结合面几何形状和摩擦时间
训练深度学习模型以预测极限抗拉强度
infographic.evidence_signal: 在最佳参数下，焊接接头的抗拉强度达到538 MPa、扭转强度达到325 MPa，且集成残差网络取得了最强的预测性能，R²≈0.81。
infographic.watch_item: 该数据集似乎仅限于L18实验设计，因此模型的泛化能力以及向其他合金、几何形式或焊接装置的迁移性可能需要进一步验证。
